roles.HBE_01: DEVELOPMENT permanently; existing exposed HBE_01_03 compression/tension c3 only
roles.HBE_02: MEASUREMENT_EVAL; one selected MC specimen, all donor siblings and derivatives share role
roles.HBE_03_through_07: sealed, no new role or access

selectionRule: First metadata-eligible MC/C specimen from numeric donor >1, then numeric specimen; no outcome substitution

development.responseRole: already exposed development axial curves, not independent holdout

continuum.law: small-gradient isotropic linear elasticity, fully integrated affine source-voxel hex8
continuum.calibration: Exactly one positive shear-scale least-squares fit using both already-exposed donor1 c3 axial branches at |displacement/height|<=.02 and finest-mesh bonded response; no offset, sign, modulus bounds, curve weighting or searches
continuum.boundary: both physical end faces bonded to rigid plates, zero lateral displacement there; remaining faces zero traction; no gravity, contact or CSF
continuum.calibrationWeights: Equal weight to every admitted original row from both signed axial branches combined; repeated origin rows remain; no normalization by branch, amplitude or fitted result.
continuum.scaleInterpretation: Effective continuum shear scale conditional on nu=.45, bonded ends and creator-derived geometry; not an independent intrinsic shear measurement.

legacy.law: unchanged default equilibrium K, including divergence penalty and weak foundation; no drag, handles or runtime strain clipping
legacy.boundary: all DOFs on first/last source-center layers prescribed; physical delta and nominal-strain-matched delta*(height-dz)/height both reported

geometry: Center-in-circle voxel selection, radius4mm, exact creator-derived height. New numerical-only sequence reduces the area oscillation observed before any donor2 response access. No response-driven mesh or model selection.

admissionBeforeHeldOutRead.interpretation: Prespecified three-mesh stability and domain check, not proof of asymptotic convergence or experimental uncertainty.
admissionBeforeHeldOutRead.lastTwoPlusPriorFineSlopeEnvelopeDefinit: (max-min)/new finest unit-mu slope across new20, new28 and preserved v1 finest24; guards fortuitous consecutive raster-area agreement

scoring.points: Every original signed row with |displacement/height|<=.02, no interpolation or post-reveal point exclusions; each branch must have at least3 points
primary: force RMSE N per branch at finest mesh
signed force error N at largest absolute admitted displacement
scoring.uncertainty: No metrology covariance or clinical tolerance supplied. Report mesh response band and source-derived geometry. One specimen, correlated branches, no population interval.
scoring.verdict: descriptive independent-donor response agreement only; no automatic physiological acceptance even if RMSE improves
scoring.zeroConvention: Raw released signed displacement and force, unchanged absolute zero. No preload subtraction, offset, sign alignment, baseline shift or clamping.
scoring.calibrationConfounding: Development-calibrated continuum versus unchanged default legacy; any holdout advantage combines calibration, material, boundary and discretization differences.

prohibited: all donor1 torsion and other sealed curves
donor2 c1 or torsion, sibling specimen values
refitting or changing model after donor2 reveal

claims.independentUnit: one donor-held-out motor-cortex specimen, not an external-cohort test

priorFailedAttempt.reason: finest reaction slope change 7.03% / 7.12% exceeded unchanged 5% limit; no new response reads or acquisition
